title: Haryana RTI Online portal
provision: Portal scope, payment methods and second-appeal limitation
excerpt: The portal covers Haryana authorities, accepts applications and first appeals, lists six online payment routes, and currently directs second appeals to manual filing in triplicate.
notes: Portal is desktop-oriented and gives special headquarters routing instructions for district/divisional information.

legalRti.notes: Operational behavior must be reviewed with the rules.
